rubrics.justification: The image does not clearly show a well-expanded blastocyst with a blastocoel filling most of the embryo or obvious zona thinning/hatching. ICM and TE are poorly defined, so assigning 3BB/4BB and describing clear B-grade ICM/TE overstates features not reliably visible.
It integrates age, ovarian reserve, endometrium, sperm data, and cycle history with prognosis reasonably well, though some links (e.g., BMI/nutrition impact on implantation) are somewhat speculative.

The structure is logical overall, but the implantation estimate is built on a likely overcalled morphology grade, and some conclusions (fresh transfer suitability, progesterone dosing comment) are not strongly supported by the provided data.

General principles are mostly aligned, but morphology grading appears overconfident for the image, recommending PGT-A after a single failed transfer at age 27 is not standard, and DNA fragmentation/TESE suggestions are more selective than routine guideline-based advice.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and future planning, including luteal support, nutrition review, and consideration of further male-factor workup, though some recommendations are broader than necessary for this straightforward first cycle.
